Drew (PM): Quick sync — we need a final acceptance checklist for the Console Observability PRD (dashboards, tracing sampling, retention tiers, UX flows). Major ask: customer exceptions / edge cases that block GA. Can owners call out gaps?
Alice M: I can own dashboards acceptance. Need clarity on 'time-range linking' behaviour across widgets — should it be global by default? Customers asked for opt-out per-dashboard.
Ben K: For tracing sampling, product wants dynamic sampling rules. Engineering note: dynamic rules add rollout complexity. Is the acceptance criteria 'support rule config + rollout plan' or 'live dynamic rollout'?
Drew (PM): Good Q. Acceptance should require: config + validated fallback (static sampling) + rollout playbook in docs. Not full dynamic UI for launch.
Carla S: UX note — retention tier change flow must warn about irreversible down-scaling (data loss). We need microcopy and a confirmation modal pattern. Also add a 'preview of estimated storage impact' on the modal.
Fabian (eng): Storage preview is doable if we approximate via recent ingest rates. Will carve a quick endpoint: `/api/v1/preview-retention` that returns `estimated_gb_month`. Need an RFC on the error cases (missing ingest metrics).
Drew (PM): Put that endpoint in the PRD as a dependency. Acceptance: preview endpoint exists OR clear fallback copy ("estimate unavailable").
Alice M: Checklist item suggestion for dashboards: 1) Widget-level time-range respects global toggle, 2) Export CSV for table widgets, 3) Saved views accessible via API.
Ben K: For tracing: define edge cases — skewed clocks, partial spans, and retransmitted spans. Acceptance tests should include a synthetic trace with dropped spans to validate UI resilience.
Carla S: Add accessibility checks: keyboard nav for trace flamegraph, contrast for retention tier badges.
Fabian (eng): Ops: we must add a data-migration runbook for retention tier decreases. If users lower retention, we should schedule a GC within 24h and emit audit events. Acceptance: runbook + automated audit logs.
Drew (PM): Customer exceptions — several enterprise customers demanded per-tenant retention overrides and export hooks. Decision: GA scope = per-org tiers only; per-tenant override will be beta/opt-in with a known limitations doc. Document that in PRD.
Alice M: @Drew (PM) can we add acceptance criterion: "Limitations doc linked in UI with CTA to request per-tenant beta". Adds clarity for sales/customer success.
Drew (PM): Yes. Add that. Also we should include error budget impact estimate: dashboard queries + trace queries. Ben, can you produce a rough latency/cost delta for default config?
Ben K: Will do. Rough numbers by EOD: 95th p50 token? kidding :) — I mean p95 query latency and cost delta.
Fabian (eng): One more edgecase: cross-region read-after-write for private deployments. Acceptance: documented fallback (read replicas eventually consistent) + test notes.
Carla S: UX flow question: when a user changes retention, do we show progressive countdown or immediate "effective upon GC"? Recommend: show both — effective date + estimate progress bar.
Drew (PM): Ok. Owners: Alice -> dashboards + UX copy; Ben -> tracing acceptance tests + perf estimate; Fabian -> preview endpoint, runbook, infra notes; Carla -> UX flows + accessibility. I'll own PRD edits and the limitations doc.
Alice M: I'll add a minimal sample acceptance test snippet in the PRD for dashboards:```
- Given a dashboard with a global time toggle set to ON
- When user sets widget time override
- Then global toggle should be respected or prompt to disable global toggle
```
Ben K: For tracing test snippet:```
- Inject synthetic trace with span loss and out-of-order timestamps
- Query UI for trace view -> flamegraph should render with placeholders for missing spans and not crash
```
Fabian (eng): I'll attach a short curl example for the preview endpoint in the PRD:```
curl -X POST /api/v1/preview-retention -d '{"org_id":"acme","tier":"30d"}'
```
Drew (PM): Great. Next steps: owners add checklist items to PRD by EOD Thursday. I will run a short prioritization session Friday AM to lock launch criteria. If anyone needs exceptions elevated to leadership, mention it here before EOD Wednesday.
Carla S: Noted. I'll tag design review and accessibility sign-off as blockers if not met.
Alice M: Adding one customer scenario to PRD: finance team needs exportable CSVs for audit. Mark export CSV as must-have for GA.
Ben K: Will flag any perf regressions in the perf estimate and propose mitigation (query caching TTLs).
Fabian (eng): deploy-bot: rolling-canary scheduled for test cluster 1751 tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: canary created: rollout-id=c-2026-1751, status=scheduled
Drew (PM): Thanks all. I'll update the PRD with these acceptance bullets and ping legal for data-retention wording. :thumbsup:
Carla S: :raised_hands:
Alice M: Thanks — will add checklist items now.
Ben K: On it.
